papers.title: 本册综合小练习
papers.sourceText:
一、选词填空
will, should, are, excited, in
1. We ____ going to do exercise.
2. We ____ protect our Earth.
3. I ____ visit the waterfall next holiday.
4. Fast music makes me ____.
5. We will have the festival ____ one month.
✅答案：1.are 2.should 3.will 4.excited 5.in

二、单项选择
1. —What ____ you going to do this weekend?
A. is B. are C. am
2. We ____ throw rubbish everywhere.
A. shouldn’t B. should C. will
✅答案：1.B 2.A
